forbidden_without_evidence: Rust has replaced a Python control-plane path

report_binding.comparison_rule: A runtime stream or Rust data-plane candidate must preserve the compatible report shape and bind stream.backpressure.payload.dropped_event_count before comparing metrics.

rust_scope: Rust is tracked as a future data-plane candidate for measured stream hot paths; not a whole-project rewrite.

validated_evidence.evidence: websocket connection acceptance for an existing session
validated_evidence.minimum_probe: connect to websocket /sessions/{session_id}/telemetry/live for a session created by POST /sessions

validated_evidence.evidence: startup snapshot emitted before incremental telemetry samples
validated_evidence.minimum_probe: assert first accepted stream message is stream.snapshot before telemetry.sample messages
assert observed stream sequence values increase within one session stream
reconnect with after_sequence and assert resumed messages have greater sequence values or a snapshot fallback
force a bounded slow-client queue and assert stream.backpressure reports drop_oldest_and_report
bind stream.backpressure.payload.dropped_event_count to metrics.dropped_event_count in a compatible report

validated_evidence.evidence: bounded two-client fanout keeps per-connection queues independent
validated_evidence.minimum_probe: open two simultaneous websocket clients for one session and assert each receives independent per-connection snapshot, backpressure, and monotonic retained sample messages
